reason: Expands Execution Office short track to 50,000 shekels, mandatory for corporations, allows all proceedings; faster, cheaper collection.
Exempts vehicle attachment from six-month and 2,500-shekel preconditions; creditors can attach debtor's car immediately.
Obliges municipalities to notify property-tax debtors by voice and digital channels before interest accrues; debtor-protective procedural duty.
Lets fines collection center debit debtor's bank account on due date and obtain bank details; new collection tool.
Requires registered mail and photo documentation of posted notices to debtors; extra procedural burden ensuring debtor notice.
Bans electricity cut-offs for household consumers over unpaid bills; collection only via civil means, capped deductions.
Protects war special grants from attachment, pledge and transfer for ninety days in bank; removes creditors' reach.
